headline: Modaxo Acquires Brazilian Traffic Management Firm Fiscaltech
summary: Global technology firm Modaxo has acquired Fiscaltech, expanding its footprint in Brazil's traffic management and public transit solutions sector.
why: Cross-border software and technology acquisitions reflect ongoing consolidation in niche enterprise infrastructure markets.
